watch.text: Capital deployment and utilization of the ₹600 crore raised via the QIP.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.42% weight, the holding detracted -0.239% over 3 months due to a -9.87% return, acting as the fourth largest drag on the portfolio.

watch.text: Extraordinary General Meeting on November 13, 2026 to vote on the Rs 409.04 crore preferential share issuance.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 28, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year unaudited financial results.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 29, 2026 and earnings conference call on October 30, 2026 for Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.06% of the portfolio, Arvind declined -5.91% over 3 months and -9.46% over 1 month, dampening Consumer Discretionary performance.

portfolio.statement: Aditya Birla Sun Life Small Cap Fund holds 95.4% of its ₹6,120 crore AUM in equities, with the top 10 positions representing 25.4% of the portfolio as of September 30, 2026.
interp: The portfolio exhibits a diversified small-cap spread, with Industrials (17.4%), Consumer Discretionary (16.9%), and Financials (16.5%) representing the largest three allocations.
Three-month returns were supported by capital goods and trading infrastructure positions, but offset by weakness in select staples and banking names.
portfolio.line: Gains in industrial manufacturing and market infrastructure balanced sharp drawdowns in packaged food staples and regional banking.

drivers.text: TD Power Systems contributed +0.597% on a 17.61% 3-month return following strong earnings expansion and a successful ₹600 crore QIP.
Multi Commodity Exchange contributed +0.353% with a 13.12% 3-month gain as quarterly net profit reached Rs 413 crore.
Ujjivan Small Finance Bank detracted -0.239% as shares dropped -9.87% over 3 months despite reporting tripled net profit and approving a ₹409 crore preferential issue.
